schema.description:
Describes the external assurance applied to an organization boundary.

It is used to communicate the assurance status of reporting data shared with organizations that have a
non-controlling stake in the Organizational Boundary (e.g., JV partners), and the associated facilities or
activities.
schema.title: Organizational Boundary Assurance

valid_to_datetime.description: The date and optional time to which the Organizational Boundary Assurance is valid, in ISO 8601 date time standardized format. This should be a duplicate of the associated Reporting Assurance record used for indexing; i.e., only query Organizational Boundary Assurance values assigned within a given period.

valid_from_datetime.description: The date and optional time from which the Organizational Boundary Assurance is valid, in ISO 8601 date time standardized format. This should be a duplicate of the associated Reporting Assurance record used for indexing; i.e., only query Organizational Boundary Assurance values assigned within a given period.

organizational_boundary_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Organization Boundary to which the Reporting Assurance value has been assigned.

reporting_assurance_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Reporting Assurance associated with the Organizational Boundary.

id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Organizational Boundary Assurance.

status.description: The current status of the assurance process that applies to the Organizational Boundary: None, Started, Completed.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
